title: MZT Skopje Aerodrom sweep Madzari 3-0 for 13th North Macedonian title
description: MZT Skopje Aerodrom extended their stranglehold on North Macedonian basketball with a ruthless 3-0 sweep of Madzari in the MTEL Super Liga Finals, sealing a 13th championship with an 80-74 road victory in Game 3 before 500 fans at Madjari's home court on Saturday. Coach Vasko Atanasov's side trailed 26-21 after a first quarter in which Madzari's A. Hot and T. Armstrong combined for early damage. But MZT's championship composure surfaced in the second period a 25-16 burst flipped the game to 46-42 at halftime, and the visitors never relinquished the lead from there. A 16-14 third quarter and 18-18 fourth saw MZT manage the closing stretch with the poise of serial winners, converting a perfect 15-of-15 from the free-throw line across the contest.
